statement: Each of the services, nodes and replica_operations system tables has one decoder module that turns a raw row into a frozen canonical object with named states, is the only module permitted to read that table's raw column names or COLUMN constants, and every consumer reads the decoded object; alias reads (snake_case and camelCase on one field) and state-read defaults on these three tables reach zero and the row_field_alias_reads cap tightens by the number removed.

constraints.statement: Only the table's decoder reads its raw column names. A consumer that still does is a violation the detector reports, not an allowed exception.
The decoder shapes the row it was given. It never fetches, caches or defaults a value the row lacks; an absent column is a typed refusal (R05, R07).
The row_field_alias_reads and state_read_defaults baselines are lowered in the same change by the number of sites removed.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
